newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian church says attacked by Christian rivals.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian church says attacked by Christian rivals.

text.p: The head of an evangelical church on Monday accused supporters of the dominant Ethiopian Orthodox Church of attacking his followers in southern Ethiopia, killing a number of them.
Reverend Yadesa Daba, president of the Ethiopian Evangelical Church Mekane Yesus, told Reuters he did not know how many people were killed and injured in disturbances at Arba Minch in the south.

"However I have been informed that people have lost their lives as a result of the disturbances touched off by the followers of the Orthodox Church," he said. Arba Mich is some 400 km (250 miles) south of the capital Addis Ababa.
Yadesa said his church has a permit for a four-day spiritual conference for 90,000 of its followers from Thursday.

He said Orthodox Church followers attacked the site of the conference at the town stadium, hitting people with stones and causing deaths and injuries. Three churches in the town were set ablaze and vehicles owned by the Evangelical Church were destroyed.
He said Evangelical Church followers number around 2.2 million people in Ethiopia. The Ethiopian Orthodox Church has an estimated 27 million of the country's 55 million people.
